issues.title: Allow multi-select in filter drop-downs
issues.body:
For some filters it would be useful to be able to filter on multiple values: so the user can request to see `Blue` and `Green` forces at once.

Note: this is an `OR` filter.

I _think_ this translates to all `enum` properties.
